description: Multi-provider merge accumulation: when the same flag name (SOURCED_FLAG) is supplied by both the settings provider and an additional provider, the merged flag carries the union of conditions in provider order (settings' boolean=False first, then the custom provider's boolean=True), while a flag defined only by the extra provider is still included.

cases.expected_output:
flags=2
flag=NOT_IN_SETTINGS_FLAG conditions=1
condition flag=NOT_IN_SETTINGS_FLAG name=boolean value=False
flag=SOURCED_FLAG conditions=2
condition flag=SOURCED_FLAG name=boolean value=False
condition flag=SOURCED_FLAG name=boolean value=True
